visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an extreme close-up of a mecha's head, featuring glowing green optics and a complex red horn-like structure. The camera pulls back to reveal the full figure, a highly detailed model with white, blue, and red armor plating, holding a long polearm. (2) The mecha is displayed at an exhibition booth inside a glass case, posed dynamically as if in mid-flight. The background includes display boards with QR codes and text in Japanese and English, illuminated by bright overhead gallery lighting that casts sharp shadows. (3) A shot of a large promotional poster shows the mecha standing behind a silhouette of a female character, with large blue text reading 'IMAX' and 'EQUUUX'. The lighting shifts to a cooler blue tone reflecting off the polished surfaces of the surrounding display area. (4) The camera pans across the physical model, focusing on the mechanical joints of the legs and the intricate paint applications on the torso. The background is slightly blurred, showing other attendees and display stands in the distance. (5) A series of rapid-fire studio shots on a clean white background showcase the mecha in various combat stances, emphasizing its articulation and accessories. The lighting here is perfectly flat and bright, eliminating shadows to highlight every structural detail. (6) A final close-up focuses on the chest of the robot where a golden crest is visible. Stylized text overlays appear across the center of the frame, partially obscuring the figure as it remains static in a heroic pose.

(3) The music maintains a constant high BPM, with the bass drum providing a strong, percussive foundation while the vocalist reaches a crescendo in the melody.
